about:
Wood World of Texas LLC operates from a single location in Dallas, Texas. The company does not publicly state its founding year. The business appears to be led by Craig Fyock, who authors blog posts and is listed as a contact point for inquiries.

The company functions as a specialty retailer and distributor for woodworking enthusiasts and professionals. Its inventory spans domestic and imported lumber, plywood, veneer sheets, and natural-edge slabs, alongside a curated selection of power tools from brands such as Metabo, Skil, Dewalt, and Rikon. Wood World of Texas also stocks finishing and embellishment lines from Hampshire Sheen, Chestnut Finishing, and Jimmy Clewes, as well as knife-making kits, gun-related accessories, and outdoor tools like hatchets and tomahawks. In-house services include sanding and grading of knotty alder for doors, moldings, and cabinets. The business also runs hands-on classes in knife making, cutting boards, and charcuterie boards.

The customer base includes hobbyist woodworkers, professional turners, knife makers, and gunsmiths. Pen turners purchase kits and finishing products; knife makers source blade blanks, handle materials, and sharpening tools; gunsmiths and firearm owners buy replacement grip panels for models such as Rock Island and Heritage revolvers. The shop also serves culinary enthusiasts through charcuterie-board classes and kitchen-knife kits.

Wood World of Texas positions itself as the sole authentic source for its product lines, warning against imitation websites. The company emphasizes its role as an importer of hard-to-find finishing products and boutique-manufactured items made to its own specifications and those of collaborator Jimmy Clewes.
